<thought>The most intense peak (m/z 179.0946) is likely the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.087 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 11 %) suggests about ten carbons, consistent with a formula containing nine carbons and a few heteroatoms. The formula C₉H₁₀N₂O₂ matches the mass closely (exact mass 178.0742 Da, within typical experimental error) and fits the observed isotopic distribution. No halogen or sulfur is required.  

Thus the molecular formula is C₉H₁₀N₂O₂.
